inspiration.observed_pattern: A grouped view combines CONCAT expressions with GROUP_CONCAT and a custom separator to serialize the child records associated with each parent key.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Rewritten as an independently authored project-tag report. A LEFT JOIN preserves projects without tags; CASE filters inactive tags, CONCAT builds tag labels, DISTINCT removes duplicate labels, ORDER BY makes the concatenation deterministic, and COUNT exposes the full joined-row count separately. The fixture schema, rows, and output purpose are new.

fixture_notes: Project 10 has duplicate active tags plus one inactive tag; project 20 has active tags plus a NULL tag name; project 30 has no tags; orphan tag 99 must not contribute to any project aggregate.
determinism_notes: The grouped report is ordered by the unique project ID, and GROUP_CONCAT orders tag names descending with tag ID ascending as a tie-breaker before applying its custom separator. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE projects (project_id INT PRIMARY KEY, project_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE project_tags (tag_id INT PRIMARY KEY, project_id INT NOT NULL, tag_name VARCHAR(32), active TINYINT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT p.project_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.active = 1 THEN CONCAT(t.tag_id, ':', t.tag_name) END ORDER BY t.tag_name DESC, t.tag_id ASC SEPARATOR '|') AS active_tags, COUNT(t.tag_id) AS joined_tags FROM projects p LEFT JOIN project_tags t ON t.project_id = p.project_id GROUP BY p.project_id ORDER BY p.project_id
